description: Defines classes and functions for Huffman decoding in HPACK, including HuffmanBitBuffer and HpackHuffmanDecoder, used for incremental Huffman decoding of strings in HTTP/2 HPACK compression.

classes.name: HuffmanBitBuffer
classes.description: Manages a buffer of bits for Huffman decoding, allowing appending bytes, consuming bits, and checking termination.

classes.name: HpackHuffmanDecoder
classes.description: Performs incremental Huffman decoding of HPACK-encoded strings, maintaining state across decode calls.

methods.name: HuffmanBitBuffer::Reset
methods.description: Prepares the buffer for decoding a new Huffman string.

methods.name: HuffmanBitBuffer::AppendBytes
methods.description: Adds bytes to the bit buffer for decoding.

methods.name: HuffmanBitBuffer::count
methods.description: Returns the number of bits currently in the buffer.

methods.name: HuffmanBitBuffer::IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has no bits.

methods.name: HuffmanBitBuffer::free_count
methods.description: Returns how many bits can still be added.

methods.name: HuffmanBitBuffer::ConsumeBits
methods.description: Consumes a specified number of bits from the buffer.

methods.name: HuffmanBitBuffer::InputProperlyTerminated
methods.description: Checks if the buffer's bits are properly terminated according to RFC.

methods.name: HpackHuffmanDecoder::Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state for a new string.

methods.name: HpackHuffmanDecoder::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a portion of an HPACK Huffman-encoded string, appending output symbols.

methods.name: HpackHuffmanDecoder::InputProperlyTerminated
methods.description: Checks if the remaining bits in the buffer are properly terminated.
